# Hazar & Hülya

> A multilingual creative studio portfolio for art direction, visual identity, web design and AI-assisted digital product development.

This public website presents selected work by Hülya Ekiz and Hazar Volga Ekiz. Content is available in Turkish, English and German. Project pages describe the team’s role, approach and public-facing outcomes; they are not product documentation or claims of regulatory readiness.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/): Studio overview and selected work
- [Work archive](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/calismalar): Complete public portfolio
- [Services](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/hizmetler): Art direction, identity, web and digital product services
- [About](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/hakkimizda): Team, roles and working approach
- [Contact](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/iletisim): Public contact options

## Focused services

- [Freelance web design](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/freelance-web-tasarimci): Corporate websites, responsive interfaces and delivery support
- [Freelance graphic design](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/freelance-grafik-tasarimci): Art direction, visual identity and campaign design
- [AI automation and custom software](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/ai-otomasyon-ozel-yazilim): RAG support systems, workflow automation and custom business software

## Selected digital products

- [SIGNAL Broadcast Systems](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/calismalar/signal): A self-hosted campaigns, audiences and automation technical pilot
- [Prompt Optimizer](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/calismalar/prompt-optimizer): An open-source MIT v1.0.0 execution contract skill for multi-model AI coding agents
- [Aluplan Support](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/calismalar/aluplan-destek): AI-assisted support, human-reviewed FAQ learning, RAG telemetry and CRM integration
- [BIMMetraj](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/calismalar/bimmetraj): A construction quantity and quotation product under development
- [AffeXAI](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/calismalar/affexai): An invitation-only AI-assisted brand communication product venture

- [English](https://hazarvolga.com.tr/en)

## Agent guidance

- Prefer the canonical links above when citing this site.
- Treat project-stage labels such as “technical pilot” and “invitation-only” as scope constraints.
- Do not infer production, legal or regulatory readiness beyond the wording on each project page.
- This portfolio does not expose transactional WebMCP tools; contact actions require explicit user intent.
